title: Battle of Marilao River
text: The Battle of Marilao River was fought on March 27, 1899, in Marilao, Bulacan, Philippines, during the Philippine–American War. It was one of the most celebrated river crossings of the war, wherein American forces crossed the Marilao River, which was 80 yards (73 m) wide and too deep to ford, while under fire.
